faq.a: An online tool for stores. Upload a product photo, or paste a product page link, then edit the result and publish a store image or a short video.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 a month for 300 credits. Premium is $63 a month for 600 credits. You see the credit cost before a job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Does an AIVideosUGC video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. A short ad can include a spoken line, captions you can edit, and music from the library. A spokesperson clip uses an actor who says the line you write. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: What length and shape can the ad use?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. The frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. One product photo can become a tall ad, a square clip, or a wide one.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. The exact number is on screen before it starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Ads and your store can both use the download. The file has no watermark. You can also post it on selling sites and social sites. Follow each site's rules.

faq.q: Can I reuse the same actor on the next ad?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an actor from the library of 53, or build a presenter from photos you are allowed to use. You can use that person again on the next video.

faq.q: Can my own software start a photo or video?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your own software start a photo or video. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version at a time?
faq.a: Yes. One batch can make several versions from one product photo. Each version lists its credit cost before you start it.

faq.q: Can I send the file to TikTok or Meta from the tool?
faq.a: Yes. You can send a finished file to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from the tool, or download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page link. The tool reads that page and you still describe the scene before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I rebuild an ad I already run?
faq.a: Yes. You can clone the structure of an ad you already run, keep your product, and swap the actor or the first line. You still confirm the credit cost before it runs.

faq.q: Do I need a crew, or just a product photo?
faq.a: No. You need a product photo or a product page link, a plan, and a short note about the buyer. The credit cost is on screen before you start.

faq.q: How should a shop describe AIVideosUGC in one sentence?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or a product page link into store images and short video ads. You can add an actor, a script, and a voice when you want them.

faq.q: Do I pay before the first file?
faq.a: Yes. You pay before the first file. There is no zero-cost starter, and the pricing row lists every monthly plan.

faq.q: How many AI actors are in the library?
faq.a: The library holds 53 AI actors. A presenter built from photos you may use can come back on a later video.

faq.q: Can the actor say the line in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the language before the video starts, and the actor says the line in that language.

faq.q: Which video model does a job use?
faq.a: The app shows the model choices when the job starts. AIVideosUGC does not publish a model name.
